newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to approve $500 mln GSM licence deal.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to approve $500 mln GSM licence deal.

text.p: Turkey's Transport Ministry has signed a $500 million GSM (Global System for Mobile communications) licence agreement with local GSM operator Turkcell, the Anatolian agency reported on Tuesday.
Transport Minister Omer Barutcu was quoted as saying that the agreement, signed late on Monday, was sent to the cabinet for approval.
The deal will require the licencee to pay $500 million in one year, instead of two years as stated in previous agreements.
Turkcell is one of two GSM operators in Turkey, alongside Telsim.
Government officials said previously that revenues of $1 billion were expected from the sale of GSM licences.
Barutcu said the ministry planned to raise a $5 monthly fee from mobile phone subscribers, in line with European levels.
